notes: TRACKR faster and smoother: 3D zoom now slides on the graphics card like 2D (zoom stays under the cursor); zooming in no longer repaints the map mid-scroll (it sharpens the moment you stop); only on-screen city labels move each frame; unchanged routes are no longer redrawn on refresh; the work after a zoom ends is staged so it doesn't hitch; zoom-to-load is quicker.
